## 3. Lose the acceptance response and race matching retries

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<Move To task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

The client never received this response.

## 5. A deliberate new Task gets the next permanent Asset sequence

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<next submission>",
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 2,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 3,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 3,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<next task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<next submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```
